title: RunResult
description: Output contract: one result row per run, single-line JSON (pd.read_json(lines=True)-friendly). Mirrors clustering.benchmark.metrics.RunResult (Scala). Fields are grouped into CORE (engine-neutral - every engine MUST emit) and ENGINE METRICS (Spark-flavoured today; Flink emits the analogue where one exists, else 0). See contract/README.md for the cross-engine mapping.

errorMessage.description: CORE. Present/non-null only when status='failed'. Omitted when None.

datasetMetadata.description: CORE. e.g. format, nFeatures, numPoints, seed, numPartitions.

sparkConf.description: CORE (engine config echo). Spark emits this key today; Flink MAY emit 'engineConf' instead.

engineConf.description: CORE (neutral alias of sparkConf). Either key is accepted by analysis.

nFeatures.description: CORE. Feature dimensionality. Omitted when unknown.

shuffleReadBytes.description: ENGINE. Spark shuffle read; Flink: network bytes received (or 0).

shuffleWriteBytes.description: ENGINE. Spark shuffle write; Flink: network bytes sent (or 0).

diskBytesSpilled.description: ENGINE. Spark spill to disk; Flink managed-memory spill (or 0).

jvmGcTimeMs.description: ENGINE. JVM GC time across workers (or 0).

executorCpuTimeNs.description: ENGINE. Aggregate worker CPU time, ns (or 0).

executorRunTimeMs.description: ENGINE. Aggregate worker run time, ms (or 0).

avgCpuCoresBusy.description: ENGINE. executorCpuTimeNs / (totalDurationMs * 1e6) = avg cores busy over the run. Omitted when duration <= 0.

taskCount.description: ENGINE. Spark tasks; Flink subtask deployments (or 0).

stageCount.description: ENGINE. Spark stages; Flink: number of vertices/regions (or 0).

peakExecutorMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Peak per-worker JVM/managed memory, MAX of a single worker (or 0).

totalExecutorMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. SUM of per-worker heap peaks = cluster memory footprint (or 0).

peakOnHeapExecutionBytes.description: ENGINE. Spark-only. Peak on-heap execution region (shuffle/join/sort/agg); 0 in local mode or Flink.

peakOnHeapStorageBytes.description: ENGINE. Spark-only. Peak on-heap storage region (cache/broadcast); 0 in local mode or Flink.

peakOnHeapUnifiedBytes.description: ENGINE. Spark-only. Peak whole unified on-heap pool (execution + storage); 0 in local mode or Flink.

nClusters.description: CORE. Number of non-noise clusters found. Omitted when 'nClusters' not requested in EvaluationSpec.metrics.

noiseFraction.description: CORE. Fraction labelled noise (label -1). Omitted when 'noiseFraction' not requested.

silhouette.description: CORE. Silhouette score, possibly subsampled. Omitted when not computed.

clusterSizes.description: CORE. clusterId(string) -> size. Omitted when 'clusterSizes' not requested.
